title: anthyllis vulneraria proles vulgaris
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria proles vulgaris, commonly known as Kidney Vetch, is a flowering plant species within the legume family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch include promoting wound healing, reducing pain and swelling, and supporting the urinary system, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
